\[
\bigcup_i \operatorname{conv}(C_i)
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(C_i\): The objects
- \(\\operatorname{conv}\): The convex hull

C_i are the objects, the connected parts of the foreground. The hull of each is computed from the midpoints of the edges of its pixels, and every pixel whose center lies inside the hull or on its border becomes foreground. This matches skimage.morphology.convex_hull_object.
